description: Diodes Incorporated AP2112K-3.3 — 3.3 V fixed LDO regulator, 600 mA, SOT-23-5. Low quiescent current (~55 µA) makes it the battery-powered alternative to AMS1117-3.3. ~250-400 mV dropout at 600 mA; integrated EN pin lets the MCU shut the rail down for sleep.
name: ap2112k-3v3
watch_out_for: EN (pin 3) is active-HIGH — tie to Vin if unused, or you'll get no output. Requires 1 µF input + 1 µF output ceramic caps minimum (X5R/X7R) for stability. ~250-400 mV dropout means it works down to Vin ≈ 3.7 V for a full single-LiPo discharge. For higher current (>600 mA) step up to NCP1117 / RT9013 / TPS7A03 families.
